mapper.sql: ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC

p.status = 'SUCCESS' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_payment_attempt fact_attempt WHERE fact_attempt.id = ( SELECT latest_fact_attempt.id FROM t_payment_attempt latest_fact_attempt WHERE latest_fact_attempt.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id ORDER BY latest_fact_attempt.created_at DESC, latest_fact_attempt.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND fact_attempt.attempt_status = '成功' AND fact_attempt.completed_at IS NOT NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT p.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, p.order_no AS orderNo, p.channel_transaction_no AS channelTransactionNo FROM t_payment_order p INNER JOIN t_prepay_order pr ON pr.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id LEFT JOIN t_payment_expiry_close_retry retry ON retry.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id WHERE p.status = 'PREPAY_CREATED' AND NULLIF(TRIM(p.channel_transaction_no), '') IS NULL AND pr.expires_at < NOW() AND (retry.next_retry_at IS NULL OR retry.next_retry_at <= NOW()) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_payment_attempt pa WHERE pa.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id ) GROUP BY p.payment_order_id, p.order_no, p.channel_transaction_no ORDER BY MIN(pr.expires_at) ASC, p.payment_order_id ASC LIMIT #{batchSize}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_payment_expiry_close_retry( payment_order_id, retry_count, retry_interval_seconds, next_retry_at, last_error_message, last_failed_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{paymentOrderId}, 1, #{initialIntervalSeconds}, TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{initialIntervalSeconds}, NOW()), #{errorMessage}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_at = TIMESTAMPADD( SECOND, LEAST(#{maxIntervalSeconds}, retry_interval_seconds * #{backoffFactor}), NOW() ), retry_interval_seconds = LEAST(#{maxIntervalSeconds}, retry_interval_seconds * #{backoffFactor}), last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, last_failed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_payment_expiry_close_retry WHERE id IN ( SELECT stale.id FROM ( SELECT retry.id FROM t_payment_expiry_close_retry retry LEFT JOIN t_payment_order p ON p.payment_order_id = retry.payment_order_id WHERE p.payment_order_id IS NULL OR p.status != 'PREPAY_CREATED' OR NULLIF(TRIM(p.channel_transaction_no), '') IS NOT NULL OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_prepay_order pr WHERE pr.payment_order_id = retry.payment_order_id AND pr.expires_at < NOW() ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_payment_attempt pa WHERE pa.payment_order_id = retry.payment_order_id ) ORDER BY retry.id LIMIT #{batchSize} ) stale )
mapper.select: SELECT p.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, pr.prepay_order_no AS prepayOrderNo, b.bill_no AS billNo, p.order_no AS orderNo, p.customer_name AS customerName, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(p.amount, 2)) AS amount, p.payment_method AS paymentMethod, p.channel_code AS channel, p.channel_transaction_no AS channelTransactionNo, p.last_channel_return_code AS channelReturnCode, p.last_standardized_code AS standardizedCode, p.last_standardized_message AS standardizedMessage, p.last_handling_suggestion AS handlingSuggestion, p.last_retryable AS retryable, p.last_manual_intervention_required AS manualInterventionRequired, p.last_mapping_version AS returnCodeMappingVersion, p.last_mapping_matched AS returnCodeMappingMatched, pa.terminal AS latestTerminal, pa.client_ip AS latestClientIp, pa.idempotency_key AS latestIdempotencyKey, pa.attempt_status AS latestAttemptStatus, pa.attempt_status_type AS latestAttemptStatusType, DATE_FORMAT(pa.completed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS latestAttemptCompletedAt, pa.ops_config_snapshot_version AS opsConfigSnapshotVersion, pa.request_payload AS latestRequestPayload, pa.response_payload AS latestResponsePayload, p.status, p.status_type AS statusType, DATE_FORMAT(p.success_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS successAt, DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM t_payment_order p LEFT JOIN t_prepay_order pr ON pr.id = ( SELECT latest_pr.id FROM t_prepay_order latest_pr WHERE latest_pr.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id ORDER BY latest_pr.created_at DESC, latest_pr.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN t_bill b ON b.bill_no = pr.bill_no LEFT JOIN t_payment_attempt pa ON pa.id = ( SELECT latest_pa.id FROM t_payment_attempt latest_pa WHERE latest_pa.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id ORDER BY latest_pa.created_at DESC, latest_pa.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE p.payment_order_id = #{paymentOrderId}

SELECT p.status, pa.attempt_status AS latestAttemptStatus FROM t_payment_order p LEFT JOIN t_payment_attempt pa ON pa.id = ( SELECT latest_pa.id FROM t_payment_attempt latest_pa WHERE latest_pa.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id ORDER BY latest_pa.created_at DESC, latest_pa.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE p.payment_order_id = #{paymentOrderId}
SELECT order_amount FROM t_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO t_payment_prepay_creation_lock(order_no, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{orderNo}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT order_no FROM t_payment_prepay_creation_lock WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT paid_amount FROM t_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
SELECT customer_name FROM t_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
SELECT worker_name FROM t_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
SELECT bill_no FROM t_bill WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_bill(bill_no, order_no, customer_name, bill_amount, paid_amount, bill_status, bill_status_type, due_at, created_at) VALUES (#{billNo}, #{orderNo}, #{customerName}, #{orderAmount}, #{paidAmount}, #{billStatus}, #{billStatusType}, TIMESTAMPADD(DAY, 1, NOW()), NOW())

INSERT INTO t_payment_order(payment_order_id, order_no, customer_name, amount, payment_method, channel_code, channel_transaction_no, status, status_type, created_at) VALUES (#{paymentOrderId}, #{orderNo}, #{customerName}, #{amount}, '待选渠道', #{channelCode}, NULL, 'PREPAY_CREATED', 'info', NOW())

INSERT INTO t_prepay_order(prepay_order_no, bill_no, order_no, customer_name, amount, pay_scene, cashier_title, cashier_status, cashier_status_type, payment_order_id, created_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{prepayOrderNo}, #{billNo}, #{orderNo}, #{customerName}, #{amount}, #{payScene}, #{cashierTitle}, '待支付', 'warn', #{paymentOrderId}, NOW(), TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR, 1, NOW()))
mapper.select: SELECT prepay_order_no AS prepayOrderNo, bill_no AS billNo, order_no AS orderNo, customer_name AS customerName, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(amount, 2)) AS amount, pay_scene AS payScene, cashier_title AS cashierTitle, cashier_status AS cashierStatus, cashier_status_type AS cashierStatusType, payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS expiresAt FROM t_prepay_order WHERE prepay_order_no = #{prepayOrderNo}

SELECT pr.prepay_order_no AS prepayOrderNo, pr.bill_no AS billNo, pr.order_no AS orderNo, pr.customer_name AS customerName, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(pr.amount, 2)) AS amount, pr.pay_scene AS payScene, pr.cashier_title AS cashierTitle, pr.cashier_status AS cashierStatus, pr.cashier_status_type AS cashierStatusType, pr.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, p.status AS paymentStatus, DATE_FORMAT(pr.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(pr.expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS expiresAt FROM t_prepay_order pr INNER JOIN t_payment_order p ON p.payment_order_id = pr.payment_order_id WHERE pr.order_no = #{orderNo} AND pr.expires_at > NOW() AND pr.cashier_status IN ('待支付', '支付中') AND p.status IN ('PREPAY_CREATED', 'WAIT_CALLBACK') ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC, pr.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT prepay_order_no AS prepayOrderNo, payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, source_app_id AS sourceAppId, token_status AS tokenStatus, holder_idempotency_key AS holderIdempotencyKey, holder_terminal AS holderTerminal, holder_client_ip AS holderClientIp, DATE_FORMAT(expire_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS expireAt FROM t_payment_submit_concurrency_token WHERE prepay_order_no = #{prepayOrderNo} AND source_app_id = #{sourceAppId} LIMIT 1

SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), ' | ', notify_type, ' | ', notify_status) AS item FROM t_payment_notify_log WHERE payment_order_id = #{paymentOrderId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), ' | ', route_rule, ' | ', route_result) AS item FROM t_payment_route_record WHERE payment_order_id = #{paymentOrderId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT CONCAT(event_type, ' | ', event_topic, ' | ', publish_status, ' | ', DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) AS item FROM t_payment_event WHERE payment_order_id = #{paymentOrderId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT payment_order_id FROM t_prepay_order WHERE prepay_order_no = #{prepayOrderNo}
SELECT order_no FROM t_prepay_order WHERE prepay_order_no = #{prepayOrderNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_payment_order SET status = 'SUCCESS', status_type = 'success', channel_transaction_no = #{channelTransactionNo}, success_at = COALESCE(success_at, NOW()) WHERE payment_order_id = #{paymentOrderId} AND ( ( status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_payment_attempt submitted_attempt WHERE submitted_attempt.payment_order_id = t_payment_order.payment_order_id ) ) OR ( status = 'CLOSED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_payment_event pe WHERE pe.payment_order_id = t_payment_order.payment_order_id AND ( pe.event_type = 'PAYMENT_EXPIRED_CLOSED' OR ( pe.event_type = 'PAYMENT_CLOSED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_payment_attempt closed_attempt WHERE closed_attempt.payment_order_id = t_payment_order.payment_order_id ) ) ) ) ) )

UPDATE t_payment_attempt SET attempt_status = '成功', attempt_status_type = 'success', completed_at = COALESCE(completed_at, NOW()) WHERE id = ( SELECT latest_attempt.id FROM ( SELECT id FROM t_payment_attempt WHERE payment_order_id = #{paymentOrderId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_attempt )

UPDATE t_payment_order SET status = 'CLOSED', status_type = 'danger' WHERE payment_order_id = #{paymentOrderId} AND status = 'PREPAY_CREATED' AND NULLIF(TRIM(channel_transaction_no), '') IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_prepay_order pr WHERE pr.payment_order_id = t_payment_order.payment_order_id AND pr.expires_at < NOW() ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_payment_attempt pa WHERE pa.payment_order_id = t_payment_order.payment_order_id )

UPDATE t_payment_order SET status = 'CLOSED', status_type = 'danger' WHERE payment_order_id = #{paymentOrderId} AND status IN ('PREPAY_CREATED', 'RISK_REVIEW', 'RISK_BLOCKED', 'RISK_REJECTED') AND NULLIF(TRIM(channel_transaction_no), '') IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_payment_attempt pa WHERE pa.payment_order_id = t_payment_order.payment_order_id )
UPDATE t_prepay_order SET cashier_status = '支付中', cashier_status_type = 'info' WHERE prepay_order_no = #{prepayOrderNo} AND cashier_status IN ('待支付', '待风控复核')

UPDATE t_payment_order SET payment_method = #{paymentMethod}, channel_code = #{channelCode}, channel_transaction_no = #{channelTransactionNo}, status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK', status_type = 'warn' WHERE payment_order_id = #{paymentOrderId}

UPDATE t_payment_order SET status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK', status_type = 'danger', channel_transaction_no = COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(channel_transaction_no), ''), #{channelTransactionNo}) WHERE payment_order_id = #{paymentOrderId} AND status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' AND ( #{channelTransactionNo} IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(channel_transaction_no), '') IS NULL OR channel_transaction_no = #{channelTransactionNo} )

UPDATE t_payment_order SET last_channel_return_code = #{channelReturnCode}, last_standardized_code = #{standardizedCode}, last_standardized_message = #{standardizedMessage}, last_handling_suggestion = #{handlingSuggestion}, last_retryable = #{retryable}, last_manual_intervention_required = #{manualInterventionRequired}, last_mapping_version = #{mappingVersion}, last_mapping_matched = #{mappingMatched} WHERE payment_order_id = #{paymentOrderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_payment_submit_concurrency_token( prepay_order_no, payment_order_id, source_app_id, token_status, holder_idempotency_key, holder_terminal, holder_client_ip, release_reason, last_occupied_at, released_at, expire_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{prepayOrderNo}, #{paymentOrderId}, #{sourceAppId}, 'ACTIVE', #{holderIdempotencyKey}, #{holderTerminal}, #{holderClientIp}, NULL, NOW(), NULL, TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{expireAfterSeconds}, NOW()), NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_payment_submit_concurrency_token SET payment_order_id = #{paymentOrderId}, token_status = 'ACTIVE', holder_idempotency_key = #{holderIdempotencyKey}, holder_terminal = #{holderTerminal}, holder_client_ip = #{holderClientIp}, release_reason = NULL, last_occupied_at = NOW(), released_at = NULL, expire_at = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{expireAfterSeconds}, NOW()), updated_at = NOW() WHERE prepay_order_no = #{prepayOrderNo} AND source_app_id = #{sourceAppId} AND (token_status <> 'ACTIVE' OR expire_at < NOW())

UPDATE t_payment_submit_concurrency_token SET token_status = 'RELEASED', release_reason = #{releaseReason}, released_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE payment_order_id = #{paymentOrderId} AND token_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_payment_notify_log(notify_no, payment_order_id, channel_code, notify_type, notify_payload, notify_result, notify_status, notify_status_type, created_at) VALUES (#{notifyNo}, #{paymentOrderId}, #{channelCode}, #{notifyType}, #{notifyPayload}, #{notifyResult}, #{notifyStatus}, #{notifyStatusType}, NOW())

INSERT INTO t_payment_route_record(route_no, attempt_no, payment_order_id, channel_code, route_rule, route_result, created_at) VALUES (#{routeNo}, #{attemptNo}, #{paymentOrderId}, #{channelCode}, #{routeRule}, #{routeResult}, NOW())

INSERT INTO t_payment_event( event_no, event_type, payment_order_id, biz_no, downstream_system, event_topic, publish_status, publish_status_type, retry_count, last_published_at, next_retry_at, event_payload, created_at ) VALUES ( #{eventNo}, #{eventType}, #{paymentOrderId}, #{bizNo}, CASE WHEN #{eventType} = 'PAYMENT_SUCCESS' THEN 'accounting-system,clearing-system' WHEN #{eventType} = 'PAYMENT_CLOSED' THEN 'accounting-system' WHEN #{eventType} = 'PAYMENT_SUBMIT' THEN 'gateway-access' ELSE 'payment-core-ops' END, CASE WHEN #{eventType} = 'PAYMENT_SUCCESS' THEN 'payment.trade.succeeded.v1' WHEN #{eventType} = 'PAYMENT_CLOSED' THEN 'payment.trade.closed.v1' WHEN #{eventType} = 'PAYMENT_EXPIRED_CLOSED' THEN 'payment.trade.expired-closed.v1' WHEN #{eventType} = 'PAYMENT_SUBMIT' THEN 'payment.trade.submitted.v1' ELSE 'payment.trade.pending.v1' END, 'PENDING', 'warn', 0, NULL, TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE, 5, NOW()), #{eventPayload}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO t_payment_attempt(attempt_no, prepay_order_no, payment_order_id, channel_code, payment_method, source_app_id, terminal, client_ip, idempotency_key, request_payload, response_payload, attempt_status, attempt_status_type, created_at) VALUES (#{attemptNo}, #{prepayOrderNo}, #{paymentOrderId}, #{channelCode}, #{paymentMethod}, #{sourceAppId}, #{terminal}, #{clientIp}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestPayload}, #{responsePayload}, #{attemptStatus}, #{attemptStatusType}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_payment_attempt SET response_payload = #{responsePayload}, attempt_status = CASE WHEN completed_at IS NULL THEN #{attemptStatus} ELSE attempt_status END, attempt_status_type = CASE WHEN completed_at IS NULL THEN #{attemptStatusType} ELSE attempt_status_type END WHERE attempt_no = #{attemptNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_payment_process_log( log_no, payment_order_id, order_no, request_no, source_type, source_no, process_stage, log_level, log_level_type, message, source, created_at ) VALUES ( #{logNo}, #{paymentOrderId}, #{orderNo}, #{requestNo}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceNo}, #{processStage}, #{logLevel}, #{logLevelType}, #{message}, #{source}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT source_app_id AS sourceAppId, source_app_name AS sourceAppName, allowed_payment_methods AS allowedPaymentMethods, allowed_channel_codes AS allowedChannelCodes, allowed_merchant_nos AS allowedMerchantNos, minute_submit_limit AS minuteSubmitLimit, interface_minute_submit_limit AS interfaceMinuteSubmitLimit, token_auth_required AS tokenAuthRequired, access_token_value AS accessTokenValue, strict_mode AS strictMode, self_check_status AS selfCheckStatus, self_check_status_type AS selfCheckStatusType, self_check_message AS selfCheckMessage, status, status_type AS statusType FROM t_payment_control_policy WHERE source_app_id = #{sourceAppId} AND status = 'ENABLED' LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM t_payment_order WHERE channel_code = #{channelCode} AND status IN ('WAIT_CALLBACK', 'SUCCESS') AND created_at >= CURDATE() AND created_at < TIMESTAMPADD(DAY, 1, CURDATE())

SELECT LOWER(channel_code) AS channelCode, COUNT(1) AS queryCount, SUM(CASE WHEN notify_status = '查单失败' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failureCount FROM t_payment_notify_log WHERE notify_status IN ('已查单', '查单失败') AND created_at >= TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR, -#{lookbackHours}, NOW()) GROUP BY LOWER(channel_code) ORDER BY LOWER(channel_code)
